noNpcs: There is no one to speak with here.

greetings.akara: I am Akara. Darkness presses on the camp, and we need your help.
greetings.charsi: I'm Charsi, the camp's blacksmith. While the hammer rings, hope holds.
greetings.gheed: Gheed, at your service. A sharp eye finds treasures others overlook.
greetings.kashya: I am Kashya, captain of the Rogue archers. Darkness has taken many sisters, but we still hold this camp.
greetings.warriv: I am Warriv, leader of this caravan. The roads are dangerous, so we remain here for now.
greetings.atma: Radament's lair is a burial chamber beneath the Far Oasis. Track Radament's Lair in Quests. Once you defeat him, claim your reward there and read the Book of Skill in Inventory.

den.untracked: Demons infest the Den of Evil near camp. Track the Den of Evil in Quests, then clear the cave.
den.preclear: Demons remain in the Den of Evil. Slay them all, then return to me.
den.readyToClaim: You have cleansed the Den of Evil and given the camp some peace. Claim your reward in Quests.
den.claimed: The darkness in the Den of Evil has lifted. May your new strength guard the camp.
